name: Westinghouse Electric Company
description: Major nuclear OEM from Cranberry Township, Pennsylvania: AP1000 large reactors, AP300 SMR and the 5 MWe heat-pipe eVinci microreactor, whose test reactor was the first microreactor with an approved preliminary safety design report and reached criticality in September 2026.
